At r=28, Pr(J>=28)<1/81. Since a width-two ideal of size at most 27 is determined by two chain-prefix lengths, more than 80/81 of all extensions use at most 406 endpoint cut ideals.
At the first boundary x,y, the exact cap Pr(x<y)<7/9 implies Pr(y<x)>2/9. Hence Pr(y<x and 1<=J<=27)>17/81, carried by at most 405 nonempty shallow cut ideals.
The order-dual statements hold at the last majority boundary.
